author: Bijan Mousavi
title: Exact staged payload execution
why: Contributor validation must run the bytes being committed while preserving unstaged changes.
what: Export the complete index into an isolated local Git snapshot under artifacts. Reject unsafe paths, conflicts, unsupported objects and output collisions.
how: Bind the parent and complete tree, validate entries before writing, preserve modes and internal symlinks, and check identity after export. Prove a passing worktree cannot hide staged exit-seven code.
preserved: No stash, reset or checkout in the contributor worktree. Original npm application interfaces and production inputs remain unchanged. Only exact current report paths are excluded from identity.
risk: Snapshots use local Git object sharing and must retain the source object store during checks. Case-colliding paths and escaping symlinks fail rather than execute an ambiguous candidate.
limitations: Six staged-export probes, 13 developer tests and 57 report tests passed on the frozen index with Node 24.21.0/npm 11.19.0. Export does not itself execute application gates or admit a commit.
rollback: Revert export tools, tests and aliases together in a reported change. Existing manual staged inspection and application commands remain available.
